title: The Pokémon That Changes When Its HP Hits Half

direction.premise: Darmanitan can transform in battle when its HP falls to half or less.
direction.audiencePromise: Show the 50% HP trigger, the type change, and the dramatic stat swap of Zen Mode.
direction.openLoop: What happens to Pokémon #555 when its HP drops to half?
direction.payoff: Zen Mode turns Darmanitan from pure Fire into Fire/Psychic and completely reshapes its battle stats.
direction.engagementQuestion: Would you risk dropping below half HP to trigger Zen Mode?

voice.instructions: Fast, energetic Pokémon short narrator. Start punchy and surprised, build tension as the HP falls, then slow for half a beat before the Zen Mode reveal. Keep it playful, crisp, and natural. Never imitate a known person or character.

scenes.headline: HURT IT. IT TRANSFORMS.
scenes.narration: This Pokémon can transform when its health drops to half.
scenes.caption: 50% HP = TRANSFORMATION

scenes.headline: PURE FIRE. FULL POWER.
scenes.narration: Darmanitan number five fifty-five normally fights as a pure Fire type.
scenes.caption: STANDARD MODE • FIRE

scenes.narration: But with Zen Mode, the moment its HP reaches half or less, everything changes.
scenes.caption: THE TRIGGER IS 50%

scenes.headline: FIRE BECOMES FIRE + PSYCHIC
scenes.narration: It turns blue, enters Zen Mode, and becomes Fire and Psychic type.
scenes.caption: FIRE → FIRE + PSYCHIC

scenes.headline: ITS STATS FLIP TOO
scenes.narration: Its huge Attack collapses, while Special Attack and both defenses jump massively.
scenes.caption: 140 ATTACK → 140 SPECIAL ATTACK

scenes.headline: WOULD YOU TRIGGER IT?
scenes.narration: Would you risk half your health just to unlock Zen Mode?
scenes.caption: RISK IT FOR ZEN MODE?
